_comment: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and edit. Keys can also go in ../keys.txt instead.

_notes.tickers: Any valid ticker symbols. Add as many as you want.
_notes.api_keys: Leave [] to load from the LLM_API_KEYS env var / .env (recommended - keeps keys out of config). Or paste keys here.
_notes.finnhub_key: Optional. Improves quote data. Free key at finnhub.io.
_notes.interval_hours: Hours between full runs (default 24 = once per day).
_notes.run_on_start: If true, run immediately on launch; if false, wait interval_hours first.
_notes.retries_per_ticker: Extra LLM attempts if the model returns an unparseable response.
_notes.skip_when_market_open: If true, cycles during US trading hours (Mon-Fri 9:30-16:00 ET) are skipped.
_notes.provider: Set the LLM_PROVIDER env var: cerebras (default) | groq | gemini. Override model with LLM_MODEL.
